WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS max_purchase_date,
    (MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date - INTERVAL '24 months')::date AS start_purchase_date
  FROM orders o
),
top_categories AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category_name_english,
    ABS(SUM(oi.price)) AS total_sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp::date >= (SELECT start_purchase_date FROM bounds)
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp::date <= (SELECT max_purchase_date FROM bounds)
  GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
  ORDER BY total_sales DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
months AS (
  SELECT to_char(month::date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
         month::date AS month_start
  FROM generate_series(
    (SELECT start_purchase_date FROM bounds),
    (SELECT max_purchase_date FROM bounds),
    INTERVAL '1 month'
  ) AS month
),
monthly_sales_by_cat AS (
  SELECT
    to_char(date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS product_category_name_english,
    ABS(SUM(oi.price)) AS monthly_sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp::date >= (SELECT start_purchase_date FROM bounds)
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp::date <= (SELECT max_purchase_date FROM bounds)
    AND COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) IN (SELECT product_category_name_english FROM top_categories)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  m.month,
  tc.product_category_name_english,
  COALESCE(ms.monthly_sales, 0) AS monthly_sales
FROM months m
CROSS JOIN (SELECT product_category_name_english FROM top_categories) tc
LEFT JOIN monthly_sales_by_cat ms
  ON ms.month = m.month
  AND ms.product_category_name_english = tc.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY m.month, tc.product_category_name_english;
